_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json. ADR-031 declarative-first (lifecycle annotations + calculations + aggregations). ADR-022 approval-workflow consumption (no app-local approval table).
_meta.description: Tier-2 dual-mode settlement extension on expense-capture-core. Adds the settlementMode enum (reimbursable | pass-through) + pass-through linking fields (linkedCustomerId, markupRuleId, markupRateApplied, markupAmountCalculated, passthroughDebitAccountCode) to Receipt / MileageEntry / PerDiem (REQ-ERP-001, REQ-ERP-002). Extends ExpenseClaimEntry with claim-level settlementMode, dual-path aggregate totals (totalReimbursableAmount, totalPassThroughAmount), unique customer IDs, and two GL transaction back-references (glReimbursableTransactionId, glPassThroughTransactionId) plus invoiced lifecycle state for the pass-through path (REQ-ERP-003, REQ-ERP-007). Declares two new master-data schemas — ReimbursementPolicy (per-administration auto-approve thresholds + markup-approval thresholds + employee bank account mapping, REQ-ERP-004 / REQ-ERP-006) and PassThroughMarkupRule (per-customer / per-category percentage or fixed markup with priority (customer+category > customer > global), REQ-ERP-005). Money fields use multipleOf 0.01 (Euro / percent 2-decimal precision). Markup calculation is declared as x-openregister-calculations on each expense schema (declarative lookup of the matching PassThroughMarkupRule); claim aggregates are declared as x-openregister-aggregations on ExpenseClaimEntry (sum + unique). GL materialisation branches on settlementMode via a dual-path action set on the post transition (REQ-ERP-007, REQ-ERP-008, REQ-ERP-009): reimbursable debits the expense-payable account + emits ExpenseClaimReimbursementNotification for the treasury module, pass-through debits the customer AR account + credits revenue-deferral. Markup rate locking is enforced by declarative immutability metadata (locked on submit per REQ-ERP-010); settlement-mode change post-posting requires GL reversal per REQ-ERP-011 (T1 REQ-GL-004 pattern).

settlementMode.description: Dual-mode settlement classification per REQ-ERP-001. reimbursable = pay employee via SEPA + GL debit expense-payable. pass-through = bill linked customer at cost + markup via AR. Immutable after parent ExpenseClaimEntry is submitted (REQ-ERP-010).
settlementMode.title: Settlement Mode

linkedCustomerId.description: FK to Organization (customer) when settlementMode = pass-through; null when reimbursable. Validated at claim submission (REQ-ERP-002).
linkedCustomerId.title: Linked Customer ID

markupRuleId.description: FK to PassThroughMarkupRule applied to this expense; populated when settlementMode = pass-through. Locked at claim submission for audit immutability (REQ-ERP-010).
markupRuleId.title: Markup Rule ID

markupRateApplied.description: Actual markup percentage applied (e.g. 0.15 for 15%) or fixed amount when markupType=fixedAmount. Resolved from PassThroughMarkupRule.markupValue at calculation time; locked on claim submission (REQ-ERP-010).
markupRateApplied.title: Markup Rate Applied

markupAmountCalculated.description: Calculated pass-through amount: amount × (1 + markupRateApplied) for percentage or amount + markupValue for fixedAmount. Derived via x-openregister-calculations; locked on claim submission (REQ-ERP-002, REQ-ERP-010).
markupAmountCalculated.title: Markup Amount Calculated

passthroughDebitAccountCode.description: GL account code for the pass-through debit line (customer AR or deferred revenue). Defaults from ReimbursementPolicy.passthroughDebitAccountCode for the administration; overridable per claim. Required when settlementMode = pass-through (REQ-ERP-002).
passthroughDebitAccountCode.title: Passthrough Debit Account Code

markupLookup.description: Resolves the matching PassThroughMarkupRule for this expense and populates markupRuleId + markupRateApplied + markupAmountCalculated when settlementMode = pass-through (REQ-ERP-002, REQ-ERP-005 priority: customer+category > customer-only > global default). When settlementMode != pass-through the targets are forced null. Declarative lookup; locked at claim submission per REQ-ERP-010.
markupLookup.expression: @self.settlementMode == 'pass-through' ? lookup('PassThroughMarkupRule', {targetCustomerId: @self.linkedCustomerId, targetCategory: @self.category, administrationId: @self.administrationId, effectiveFromYear: year(@self.receiptDate)}, {priority: ['targetCustomerId+targetCategory', 'targetCustomerId', 'global']}) : null

settlementMode.description: Dual-mode settlement classification per REQ-ERP-001. Mileage may be reimbursed to employee (SEPA) or billed to client (cost + markup). Immutable after parent ExpenseClaimEntry is submitted (REQ-ERP-010).
settlementMode.title: Settlement Mode

linkedCustomerId.description: FK to Organization (customer) when settlementMode = pass-through (REQ-ERP-002).
linkedCustomerId.title: Linked Customer ID

markupRuleId.description: FK to PassThroughMarkupRule. Locked at claim submission (REQ-ERP-010).
markupRuleId.title: Markup Rule ID

markupRateApplied.description: Markup percentage or fixed amount applied at calculation time; locked on submission (REQ-ERP-010).
markupRateApplied.title: Markup Rate Applied

markupAmountCalculated.description: Pass-through amount: totalAmount × (1 + markupRateApplied) or totalAmount + markupValue (REQ-ERP-002).
markupAmountCalculated.title: Markup Amount Calculated

passthroughDebitAccountCode.description: GL account code for pass-through debit (customer AR or deferred revenue). Defaults from ReimbursementPolicy (REQ-ERP-002).
passthroughDebitAccountCode.title: Passthrough Debit Account Code

markupLookup.description: Mirrors Receipt.markupLookup for mileage lines (REQ-ERP-005). Looks up PassThroughMarkupRule matching linkedCustomerId + category (mileage category resolves to 'travel') with priority customer+category > customer-only > global; calculates cost + markup; locks on claim submission per REQ-ERP-010.
markupLookup.expression: @self.settlementMode == 'pass-through' ? lookup('PassThroughMarkupRule', {targetCustomerId: @self.linkedCustomerId, targetCategory: 'travel', administrationId: @self.administrationId, effectiveFromYear: year(@self.travelDate)}, {priority: ['targetCustomerId+targetCategory', 'targetCustomerId', 'global']}) : null

settlementMode.description: Dual-mode settlement classification per REQ-ERP-001. Per-diem may be reimbursed to employee (SEPA) or billed to client (cost + markup). Immutable after parent ExpenseClaimEntry is submitted (REQ-ERP-010).
settlementMode.title: Settlement Mode

linkedCustomerId.description: FK to Organization (customer) when settlementMode = pass-through (REQ-ERP-002).
linkedCustomerId.title: Linked Customer ID

markupRuleId.description: FK to PassThroughMarkupRule. Locked at claim submission (REQ-ERP-010).
markupRuleId.title: Markup Rule ID

markupRateApplied.description: Markup percentage or fixed amount; locked on submission (REQ-ERP-010).
markupRateApplied.title: Markup Rate Applied

markupAmountCalculated.description: Pass-through amount: allowanceAmount × (1 + markupRateApplied) or allowanceAmount + markupValue (REQ-ERP-002).
markupAmountCalculated.title: Markup Amount Calculated

passthroughDebitAccountCode.description: GL account code for pass-through debit. Defaults from ReimbursementPolicy (REQ-ERP-002).
passthroughDebitAccountCode.title: Passthrough Debit Account Code

markupLookup.description: Mirrors Receipt.markupLookup for per-diem lines (REQ-ERP-005). Per-diem category resolves to 'meals' for rule matching unless overridden by the operator.
markupLookup.expression: @self.settlementMode == 'pass-through' ? lookup('PassThroughMarkupRule', {targetCustomerId: @self.linkedCustomerId, targetCategory: 'meals', administrationId: @self.administrationId, effectiveFromYear: year(@self.fromDate)}, {priority: ['targetCustomerId+targetCategory', 'targetCustomerId', 'global']}) : null

settlementMode.description: Claim-level dual-mode classification per REQ-ERP-001 / REQ-ERP-003. All line items (Receipt / MileageEntry / PerDiem) MUST have matching settlementMode (mixed-mode claims rejected per REQ-ERP-003). Immutable after submission unless an authorised operator triggers GL reversal per REQ-ERP-011.
settlementMode.title: Settlement Mode

totalReimbursableAmount.description: Sum of Receipt.amountInBaseCurrency + MileageEntry.totalAmount + PerDiem.allowanceAmount where settlementMode = reimbursable. Aggregated declaratively (REQ-ERP-003).
totalReimbursableAmount.title: Total Reimbursable Amount

totalPassThroughAmount.description: Sum of line markupAmountCalculated values where settlementMode = pass-through (cost + markup). Aggregated declaratively (REQ-ERP-003).
totalPassThroughAmount.title: Total Pass Through Amount

passThroughCustomerIds.description: Unique list of linkedCustomerId values across pass-through line items. Populated declaratively for multi-customer pass-through claims (REQ-ERP-003, REQ-ERP-009).
passThroughCustomerIds.title: Pass Through Customer Ids

glReimbursableTransactionId.description: Back-reference to materialised GLTransaction for the reimbursable path (debit expense-payable, credit cost centres). Set by the reimbursable-path post action (REQ-ERP-007).
glReimbursableTransactionId.title: GL Reimbursable Transaction ID

glPassThroughTransactionId.description: Back-reference to materialised GLTransaction for the pass-through path (debit customer AR, credit cost centres + revenue-deferral). Set by the pass-through path post action (REQ-ERP-007).
glPassThroughTransactionId.title: GL Pass Through Transaction ID

reimbursementPolicyId.description: FK to the ReimbursementPolicy applied to this claim — determines auto-approve threshold, optional markup-approval threshold, and the employee bank account mapping (REQ-ERP-004). Defaults to the administration's single active policy when null.
reimbursementPolicyId.title: Reimbursement Policy ID

settlementTotals.description: Auto-aggregates dual-path totals across linked Receipt + MileageEntry + PerDiem records grouped by settlementMode (REQ-ERP-003). Recomputed on every line-item save, frozen on submit per REQ-ERP-010. Also derives the unique passThroughCustomerIds list for downstream AR linking (REQ-ERP-009).

invoiced.label: Invoiced (pass-through)
invoiced.description: Pass-through path closure: claim cost + markup included on customer invoice; AR updated (REQ-ERP-007, REQ-ERP-009).

actions.description: REQ-ERP-007 reimbursable path: debit per expense line credit to expense-payable account (Account.isExpenseControlAccount=true); sets glReimbursableTransactionId. Identical to expense-capture-core REQ-EC-012 pattern but selected only when claim.settlementMode = reimbursable.

REQ-ERP-008 SEPA payment notification. Emits ExpenseClaimReimbursementNotification on the event bus for the treasury module to consume; logged in the OR audit trail; idempotent on (claimId, glReimbursableTransactionId). Treasury module is decoupled from Shillinq.

REQ-ERP-007 pass-through path: debit customer AR account (per Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem.passthroughDebitAccountCode, fallback ReimbursementPolicy.passthroughDebitAccountCode), credit cost centres + revenue-deferral on the markup delta. Sets glPassThroughTransactionId. Multiple GL entries are emitted when passThroughCustomerIds.length > 1 (REQ-ERP-009 multi-customer).

markReimbursed.description: REQ-ERP-007 reimbursable path closure: payment record matches claim total; SEPA instruction confirmed by treasury module. Available only when settlementMode = reimbursable.

markInvoiced.label: Mark as invoiced (pass-through)
markInvoiced.description: REQ-ERP-007 pass-through path closure: customer invoice generation cycle includes claim cost + markup on next AR invoice. Available only when settlementMode = pass-through (REQ-ERP-009).

changeSettlementMode.label: Change settlement mode (requires GL reversal)
changeSettlementMode.description: REQ-ERP-011 high-privilege transition. Reverses the existing GL entry (glReimbursableTransactionId or glPassThroughTransactionId) per T1 REQ-GL-004 before allowing a re-post with the updated settlementMode. Markup rate stays locked per REQ-ERP-010 on the original GL entry; new mode triggers a fresh lookup on re-post.

actions.description: Reverse the existing glReimbursableTransactionId or glPassThroughTransactionId per T1 REQ-GL-004.

ReimbursementPolicy.title: Reimbursement Policy
ReimbursementPolicy.description: Per-administration master-data record configuring expense settlement policy: auto-approve threshold for reimbursable claims, optional markup-approval threshold for pass-through claims, default GL account code for the pass-through debit, and the employee bank-account mapping reference for the SEPA reimbursement event (REQ-ERP-004, REQ-ERP-006, REQ-ERP-008). One active policy per administration; consumed by OR approval-workflow (ADR-022) and by the dual-path GL post action.

policyId.description: Unique policy identifier per administration (e.g. POL-NL-01).
policyId.title: Policy ID

description.example: Standard Dutch expense policy: claims ≤€500 auto-approve; pass-through markup unrestricted.
description.title: Description

autoApproveThreshold.description: Expense claims with totalAmount ≤ this value auto-approve (skip approval-workflow gating). Consumed by OR approval-workflow per ADR-022 (REQ-ERP-004).
autoApproveThreshold.title: Auto Approve Threshold

requiresMarkupApprovalThreshold.description: Pass-through claims with markup amount (totalPassThroughAmount × markupRateApplied — totalPassThroughAmount/(1+markupRateApplied)) ≥ this value require an extra approver on submitted → approved (REQ-ERP-006). Null = no extra gate. Consumed by OR approval-workflow.
requiresMarkupApprovalThreshold.title: Requires Markup Approval Threshold

passthroughDebitAccountCode.description: Default GL account code for the pass-through debit line (customer AR / deferred revenue). Per-claim override via Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem.passthroughDebitAccountCode (REQ-ERP-002, REQ-ERP-007).
passthroughDebitAccountCode.title: Passthrough Debit Account Code

employeeBankAccountMapping.description: Reference for resolving the employee SEPA account in the reimbursement notification payload. 'standard' = lookup Person.bankAccount; named overrides allow per-deployment mapping (REQ-ERP-008).
employeeBankAccountMapping.title: Employee Bank Account Mapping

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this policy. One active policy per administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

employee.description: Employees read-only to see applicable thresholds at claim submission.

PassThroughMarkupRule.title: Pass-through Markup Rule
PassThroughMarkupRule.description: Per-administration master-data record defining the markup applied to pass-through expenses. Rules target (targetCustomerId + targetCategory), (targetCustomerId only), or null+null (global default). Lookup priority — customer+category > customer-only > global default — is enforced declaratively in the lookup() expression on Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem x-openregister-calculations (REQ-ERP-005). markupType=percentage applies amount × (1 + markupValue); markupType=fixedAmount adds markupValue to amount. Effective per fiscal year; rate locks on claim submission per REQ-ERP-010 (rule changes never affect historical claims).

ruleId.description: Unique rule identifier per administration (e.g. RULE-001).
ruleId.title: Rule ID

targetCustomerId.description: FK to Organization (customer); null = applies to all customers (global default or category-only rule).
targetCustomerId.title: Target Customer ID

targetCategory.description: Expense category (travel, meals, supplies, etc.); null = applies to all categories.
targetCategory.title: Target Category

markupType.description: Markup application mode. percentage: amount × (1 + markupValue). fixedAmount: amount + markupValue per receipt/item (REQ-ERP-005).
markupType.title: Markup Type

markupValue.description: Markup value: percentage (e.g. 0.15 for 15%) when markupType=percentage; EUR amount (e.g. 2.50) when markupType=fixedAmount.
markupValue.title: Markup Value

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (EUR in T2; multi-currency markup rules deferred to T3+ per design.md D5).
currency.title: Currency

effectiveFromYear.description: Fiscal year this rule applies to. Rules with earlier effectiveFromYear are matched only when no later rule exists for the same target (REQ-ERP-005).
effectiveFromYear.title: Effective From Year

effectiveToYear.description: Last fiscal year (inclusive) this rule applies to. Null = open-ended.
effectiveToYear.title: Effective To Year

priority.description: Tie-breaker when multiple rules match (higher wins). Auto-derived: customer+category=100, customer-only=50, global=0. Operator overridable for explicit ordering.
priority.title: Priority

notes.example: Customer ABC: travel at +10% (negotiated rate per Q1 2026 contract).
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this rule.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

bookkeeper.description: Bookkeepers configure markup rules per administration.

employee.description: Employees read-only to see applicable rates at expense classification.
